notReproducible.report: Journey Highlights and Practical notes render with no visible content on the Kerala journey page
notReproducible.finding: Both sections render fully. All 7 highlights and all 4 practical notes are present in the DOM and visible in the capture, verified by cropping the delivered JPEG at 1:1.
notReproducible.actualCause: Scale. A 1440x7616 full-page capture viewed fit-to-screen is roughly 10% zoom, at which 15px body copy is sub-pixel and disappears. Practical notes were the worst case because they were 15px in muted grey.
notReproducible.fixedAnyway: Practical-notes body raised from --text-sm muted to --text-base full ink, its labels to --text-lg, and highlight text to --text-lg. These sections carry high-value copy and were genuinely too quiet.
notReproducible.alsoFixed: Review captures now ship with 1:1 crops alongside the full-page shots, so text is legible without zooming.

lcpRegressionFromRealPhotography.story: Flat placeholder graphic 1.7s, then real photography unoptimised 2.4s, then 2.0s after two fixes
fixes: hero AVIF quality 42 rather than Astro default: 960w candidate 56KB against 76KB, no visible difference at 1:1 (checked)
added a 768 rung to the hero srcset: a 412px phone at DPR 1.75 needs 721px and was being served 960px, a third more pixels than it could display
lcpRegressionFromRealPhotography.current: LCP 2.0s / 2.0s / 1.7s. FCP is 1.1s on all three, so the image has a 0.9s budget in this instrument
lcpRegressionFromRealPhotography.decisionNeeded: The 1.5s working target in CLAUDE.md invariant 3 was set when heroes were flat graphics. With real photography the code-side levers are exhausted short of visibly degrading the imagery on a photography-led premium site. 2.0s is comfortably inside the 2.5s Core Web Vitals pass mark. Either the working target moves, or hero art direction changes (smaller crops, or a blur-up placeholder). Client decision, not ours to absorb quietly.
